title: On the uniqueness of surfaces of constant spacetime mean curvature in asymptotically Schwarzschildean lightcones
summary: In this paper, we address the uniqueness of surfaces of constant spacetime mean curvature in an asymptotically Schwarzschildean lightcone of mass $m>0$. We prove that there exists a unique asymptotically flat foliation by surfaces of constant spacetime mean curvature for a fairly generic notion of asymptotic flatness. This foliation has Bondi energy $m$ and vanishing Bondi linear momentum. The authors have already established the existence of such a foliation in previous work, but proven uniqueness only in a very restrictive class of surfaces.
